docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,175.00 FILED BY MAGDALENO, JESSICA AS TO DEFENDANT GOMEZ, SERGIO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-07-2023 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
STIPULATION TO USE JUDGE PRO TEM OR HEARING OFFICER FILED BY MAGDALENO, JESSICA GOMEZ, SERGIO

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-07-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-15-2024 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JESSICA MAGDALENO IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SERGIO GOMEZ IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PARTIES REACH A SETTLEMENT IN THE COURTROOM IN THE AMOUNT OF $3,075.00 TOTAL (WHICH INCLUDES COSTS) TO BE PAID BY DEFENDANT TO PLAINTIFF IN MONTHLY INSTALLMENTS OF $500 PER MONTH ON THE THIRD FRIDAY OF EACH MONTH STARTING IN NOVEMBER 2023 FOR FIVE CONSECUTIVE MONTHS AND A FINAL PAYMENT OF $575 IN THE SIXTH CONSECUTIVE MONTH. THE COURT SETS AN INITIAL PROGRESS REPORT HEARING FOR 2/15/24 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT. 506. PARTIES ONLY NEED TO APPEAR ON 2/15/24, IF PAYMENTS HAVE BEEN FRUSTRATED, AT WHICH TIME THE COURT MAY DECIDE TO ENTER JUDGMENT FOR THE TOTAL SETTLEMENT AMOUNT MINUS ANY CREDITS FOR PARTIAL PAYMENTS MADE UP TO THAT POINT. IF THERE ARE NO APPEARANCES ON 2/15/24, THE COURT WILL SET A FINAL PROGRESS REPORT HEARING FOR 5/16/24 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT. 506. IF THERE ARE NO APPEARANCES ON 5/16/24, THE COURT WILL DISMISS PLAINTIFF'S CASE WITH PREJUDICE PER THE TERMS OF THE PARTIES SETTLEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: S. KANE. NOT REPORTED. (D. 506)
ORDER TO CONTINUE FOR PROGRESS REPORT AFTER PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-15-2024 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-16-2024 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JESSICA MAGDALENO IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT SERGIO GOMEZ IS NOT PRESENT. PARTIES ONLY NEED TO APPEAR ON 5/16/24, IF PAYMENTS HAVE BEEN FRUSTRATED, AT WHICH TIME THE COURT MAY DECIDE TO ENTER JUDGMENT FOR THE TOTAL SETTLEMENT AMOUNT MINUS ANY CREDITS FOR PARTIAL PAYMENTS MADE UP TO THAT POINT. IF THERE ARE NO APPEARANCES ON 5/16/24, THE COURT WILL DISMISS PLAINTIFF'S CASE WITH PREJUDICE PER THE TERMS OF THE PARTIES SETTLEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID FLEISIG; CLERK: D. CARTER. NOT REPORTED. (D. 506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF JESSICA MAGDALENO IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT IS SERGIO GOMEZ NOT PRESENT. PER AGREEMENT FROM 9/7/23, MATTER IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAWN PAYNE; CLERK: D. CARTER. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
